'''Zhanox''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]. Its surface was covered by [[Stone/Legends|stony]] spires, between which were rubble-strewn valleys. The mines of Zhanox were overseen by [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]], while [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] inhabited the world's valleys. The [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] [[Police officer/Legends|member]] [[Alec Mard]] [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from Zhanox.

==Description==
Zhanox was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Zhanox system/Legends|Zhanox system]], a part of the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]]. It was situated in the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]] region within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The world lay on the [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]] known as the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], which connected it to the [[Bendeluum system/Legends|Bendeluum]] and [[Ione system/Legends|Ione systems]]. Zhanox was located inside the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]].<ref name="TEA" />

[[Stone/Legends|Stony]] spires covered every square [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] of<ref name="GG" /> the Zhanoxi<ref name="TEA" /> surface, giving the world the appearance of a pincushion. The floors of the valleys between the formations were strewn with rubble from toppled spires.<ref name="GG" />

==History==
After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] victory in a [[Galactic Republic–Mugaari war|war]] against the nearby civilization of the [[Mugaari]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="GG" /> at some point between approximately [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]] and [[600 BBY/Legends|600 BBY]],<ref name="MugaariDate">{{RepublicMugaariWarDate}}</ref> the former established the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the former [[Mugaari Space/Legends|Mugaari Space]].<ref name="GG" /> Around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]],<ref name="SectorDates" /> the portion of the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] containing Zhanox was re-designated as the Anoat sector.<ref name="GG" />

==Inhabitants==
Zhanox was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world, with members of the [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] species overseeing the mines. The world's valleys were [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="GG" /> Zhanox was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the Human [[Alec Mard]], who became a [[Police officer/Legends|member]] of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]] at<ref name="Insider148">{{InsiderCite|148|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards}}</ref> the Anoat sector planet [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]<ref name="TEA" /> at some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="3 ABY">{{InsiderCite|148|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards}} establishes that [[Alec Mard]] had become a [[Police officer/Legends|member]] of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the events of {{Film|V}}, which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> Mard's homeworld was rarely visited by [[Starship/Legends|starships]] from outside the [[Twin Nebulae/Legends|Twin Nebulae]] dominating the Greater Javin.<ref name="GG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zhanox was introduced in [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement "[[Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin]]," which was published on [[Wizards.com]] on [[March 25]], [[2004]].<ref name="GG" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square K-18.<ref name="TEA" />
